  ⋯

theorem decNat_eq_decNumeral (s : List w8) : Net.decNat s = decNumeral? s

theorem addrOk_loopback (p : w64) (h1 : 1 ≤ BitVec.toNat p) (h2 : BitVec.toNat p < 32768) :
    Net.addrOk (go!"127.0.0.1:" ++ decStr p) = true

def etcdNetExts_hasFs : HasExt Fs.fsExt :=
  ⋯

theorem etcdNetFs_start [GoGlobalContext] (σ : state) (h : Fs.FsInit (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world)) :
    ⊢ extsLocalStart σ.world ={⊤}=∗ Fs.osInv ∗ ([∗map] i ↦ f ∈ (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.files,
    Fs.osFileStart i f) ∗ Fs.osTree (DFrac.own 1) (extLocal Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.roots ((extLocal
    Fs.fsExt σ.world).fs.treeDur, [])

theorem splitBy_noSep (sep : w8) (s cur : List w8) (h : ∀ (c : w8), c ∈ s → BitVec.toNat c ≠
    BitVec.toNat sep) : Net.splitBy sep s cur = [cur.reverse ++ s]

def etcdNetExtsInterp : GooseInterp :=
  { interps := (idIssue_interp, Fs.fs_interp, Net.net_interp, PUnit.unit) }

def etcdNetExtsSemantics : GooseSemantics :=
  { sems := (idIssue_semantics, etcdFsSem, Net.net_semantics, PUnit.unit) }

theorem etcdNetExts_initP (g : GlobalState) (nodes : List (Expr × state)) (Hfs : ∀ (m : Expr ×
    state), m ∈ nodes → Fs.FsInit (extLocal Fs.fsExt m.snd.world)) : extsInitGlobal g → (∀ (m : Expr
    × state), m ∈ nodes → extsInitLocal m.snd g) → extsInitgP g.globalWorld ∧ ∀ (m : Expr × state),
    m ∈ nodes → extsInitP m.snd.world g.globalWorld

theorem digitsVal_foldl (s : List w8) (acc : Nat) : Net.digitsVal s acc = List.foldl (fun acc c =>
    acc.bind fun n => if 48 ≤ BitVec.toNat c ∧ BitVec.toNat c ≤ 57 then some (10 * n + (BitVec.toNat
    c - 48)) else none) (some acc) s

    Net.netExt g)

    extsLocalStart w ⊢ Fs.osStart Fs.gooseOsGS (extLocal Fs.fsExt w)

theorem netAddrFrees_start [GoGlobalContext] (g : ExtsGlobalState exts) (As : List GoString) (hAs :
    As.Nodup) (hok : ∀ (a : GoString), a ∈ As → Net.addrOk a = true) : (extsGlobalStart g ∗ [∗list]
    a ∈ As, addrClaim a) ⊢ [∗list] a ∈ As, netAddrFree a
